newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday in bullish sentiment in the fuel and power, and chemicals before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange's (KSE) 100-share index ended 16.99 points, or 1.26 percent, up at 1,370.33 amid 119 losers and 109 gainers. Volume rose to 23 million shares from 20 million on Wednesday.

The bullish sentiment in some big issues in the two sectors helped the index go up, dealer Faisal Abbas said. Short-covering in active issues in the oversold market pushed the index up, another dealer said.
Market players think the rise was temporary and bearish sentiment is likely to creep in the next trading week, a dealer at Ali Hussain Rajabali said .
Pakistan State Oil rose 8.0 rupees to 269, Fauji Fertilizer 4.00 to 72, HUBCO 0.65 to 32.35, ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 17.75, Engro Chemical 2.50 to 137 and Sui Northern Gas 0.50 to 32.50.
